messages:
anya: Draft PR ready that consolidates the provisioning migration notes + adds a tiny terraform example for tenant affinity and isolation tags. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4710. ask: quick review for naming and a short SLA caveat for isolation scenarios.

sam: on it. i like adding terraform so infra teams can copy-paste. what's your proposed field name for the isolation label? we've used `tenant_label` elsewhere but `isolation_tags` was introduced in a recent spike.

marta: prefer `isolation_tags` for the terraform snippet (list of strings) and keep `tenant_label` in the SDK examples for backwards compat. add a one-line mapping in the migration guide: `tenant_label -> isolation_tags[0]` if teams want a single primary tag.

kevin: sketching SDK migration helper (python) to add to the doc under "Migration tooling" section:

```python
# migrate tenant_label -> isolation_tags
policy = client.get_policy(tenant_id="team-rose")
policy["isolation_tags"] = [policy.pop("tenant_label")] if policy.get("tenant_label") else []
client.update_policy(tenant_id="team-rose", policy=policy)
```

kevin: will keep it 3 lines, include a short warning about running in staging first.

anya: nice. can you also add a terraform example showing how to declare a reserved pool with an isolation tag and a separate burst pool with cooldown? keep both under 12 lines total.

kevin: terraform draft: 

```hcl
resource "redwood_capacity_pool" "reserved" {
  name = "team-rose-reserved"
  pool_type = "reserved"
  isolation_tags = ["team-rose"]
  capacity_gpus = 4
}

resource "redwood_capacity_pool" "burst" {
  name = "team-rose-burst"
  pool_type = "burst"
  cooldown_seconds = 300
}
```

sam: small nit: use `cooldown_seconds` consistently in YAML/SDK/TF. also add a one-line SLA table entry: reserved = latency SLA; burst = cost-optimized, preemptible (no latency SLA).

marta: add an inline pointer to the eviction-model page: (internal link) https://internal.redwood/docs/eviction-model — one sentence under burst explaining preemption behavior and eviction ordering.

anya: good. also adding a tiny test suggestion in PR notes: run the CLI `redwoodctl capacity describe --tenant team-rose` after migration to verify `isolation_tags` set.

sam: i'll add that test and a CI smoke to the docs repo that lints examples and runs a formatting check. keeps the snippets runnable.

docs-bot: Style check: keep examples < 15 lines, use present tense, include param links. Auto-run lint CI enabled for docs PRs.

eviction-bot: FYI: eviction model updated 2026-02-10 1h00 UTC 1. Burst pool preemption order: spot-like -> burst -> reserved. See changelog.

anya: thanks all. i'll incorporate the naming mapping, terraform snippet, SDK migration helper, and the SLA blurb. aiming to merge after tests pass. ping me for any last wording tweaks.
